description.zh: 局部剖面区分胞外细胞壁、质膜和胞质侧皮层微管。横向微纤丝有助于限制径向扩张。
description.en: The patch separates extracellular wall, plasma membrane, and cytosolic cortical microtubules. Transverse microfibrils help resist radial expansion.

description.zh: 纤维素合酶复合体沿质膜移动；皮层微管可参与引导排列，复合体并不是由微管马达拖动的囊泡。
description.en: Cellulose synthase complexes move within the plasma membrane; cortical microtubules can guide their arrangement. They are not vesicles pulled by microtubule motors.

description.zh: 合酶将胞质侧底物聚合并向胞外输出葡聚糖链；链聚集形成纤维素微纤丝，留下随合酶移动延长的轨迹。
description.en: Synthases polymerize cytosolic substrates and extrude glucan chains extracellularly. The chains assemble into microfibrils, leaving a growing trail as complexes move.

description.zh: 细胞内部的膨压向壁施加载荷。微纤丝沉积本身不等于细胞伸长，伸展还取决于壁能否松弛。
description.en: Internal turgor loads the wall. Microfibril deposition itself is not cell elongation; extension also depends on wall yielding.

description.zh: 可松弛条件下，示意壁沿纵向伸展，横向纤丝之间的距离增大；受限条件下仍有沉积，但不显示持续伸展。
description.en: The yielding wall extends longitudinally, increasing transverse-fiber spacing. In the restrained condition deposition continues without sustained extension.

description.zh: 新壁材料补充与壁松弛协调生长，但由不同机制调控。这里的条件对比是概念演示，不代表某种处理的定量结果。
description.en: New wall material and wall yielding cooperate in growth but have distinct regulation. These conditions are conceptual comparisons, not quantitative treatment results.

description.zh: 母体组织包围胚囊。卵细胞为 n，中央细胞含已融合的两个母方极核；退化的反足细胞未画出。
description.en: Maternal tissue surrounds the embryo sac. The egg is haploid; the central cell contains two already-fused maternal polar nuclei. Degenerated antipodal cells are omitted.

description.zh: 花粉管经珠孔进入一枚接受性助细胞附近，携带两个无鞭毛、不主动游动的精细胞。
description.en: The pollen tube enters through the micropyle near a receptive synergid, carrying two nonmotile sperm without flagella.

description.zh: 花粉管释放两个精细胞，接受性助细胞退化。精细胞被送到卵细胞与中央细胞的交界区域。
description.en: Tube discharge delivers both sperm to the boundary between egg and central cell; the receptive synergid degenerates.

title.en: One sperm for each female gamete

description.zh: 一个精细胞与卵融合，另一个与中央细胞融合。两精细胞的前后位置不预先限定命运，两次融合也没有固定先后。
description.en: One sperm fuses with the egg and the other with the central cell. Their original front/back positions do not fix their fate, and the two fusions have no obligatory order.

description.zh: 卵核 n 与精核 n 形成 2n 合子；中央细胞母方 2n 核与另一精核 n 形成 3n 初生胚乳核。
description.en: Egg n plus sperm n yields a 2n zygote. The maternal central-cell 2n nucleus plus the other sperm n yields a 3n primary endosperm nucleus.

description.zh: 拟南芥合子首次不等分形成较小的顶端细胞和朝珠孔的较大基部细胞；胚乳早期进行游离核分裂。形态与时间尺度为示意。
description.en: The Arabidopsis zygote first divides asymmetrically into a smaller apical cell and a larger basal cell toward the micropyle; early endosperm undergoes free-nuclear divisions. Shapes and timing are schematic.

label.zh: 被子植物胚珠与雌雄配子；叶肉细胞结构页没有这些细胞类型
label.en: Angiosperm ovule and gametes; these cell types are absent from the mesophyll structure view

description.zh: 菌丝包含多个核与带孔隔膜。新长度主要从顶端增加；后方已有的壁与隔膜保持位置。
description.en: The hypha contains multiple nuclei and porous septa. New length is added mainly at the tip; existing rear wall and septa retain their positions.

description.zh: 运输系统向顶端供应膜成分和壁合成相关货物。示意轨迹强调定向递送，不代表每个囊泡都沿同一条路径。
description.en: Transport supplies membrane and wall-synthesis cargo toward the apex. Trajectories illustrate directed delivery rather than one obligatory route for every vesicle.

description.zh: 囊泡在顶端附近的顶体聚集后再递送到质膜。顶体是动态囊泡聚集区，不是由膜包裹的细胞器。
description.en: Vesicles accumulate transiently in the Spitzenkörper before delivery to the plasma membrane. It is a dynamic cluster, not a membrane-bound organelle.

description.zh: 囊泡与顶端质膜融合，补充膜并递送合酶。几丁质和葡聚糖等壁聚合物在质膜外形成新的壁材料。
description.en: Apical exocytosis supplies membrane and synthases. Wall polymers including chitin and glucans form new material outside the plasma membrane.

description.zh: 膨压推动可延展的顶端壁扩张；持续供膜与壁合成支持极性生长。供应减少时，模型显示较少的递送与较短的伸长。
description.en: Turgor expands the yielding apical wall; membrane supply and wall synthesis sustain polarized growth. Reduced supply produces less delivery and less extension in this model.

description.zh: 顶端前进时，肩部新沉积的浅色壁束保留在后方，逐渐成为侧壁；成熟壁限制横向扩张。该场景省略内吞回收、分支与新隔膜生成。
description.en: As the tip advances, pale wall bundles deposited at its shoulders remain behind as lateral wall; maturation limits lateral expansion. Endocytic recycling, branching, and new septum formation are omitted.

label.zh: 粗糙脉孢菌菌丝顶端生长；不是酿酒酵母出芽
label.en: Neurospora crassa hyphal-tip growth, distinct from S. cerevisiae budding

description.zh: Aux/IAA 与 DNA 上的激活型 ARF 相互作用，并通过共抑制因子限制转录。低生长素对照保持这一示意状态。
description.en: Aux/IAA interacts with an activating ARF on DNA and restricts transcription through corepressors. The low-auxin control retains this schematic state.

description.zh: 生长素进入 TIR1 的结合口袋，增强 Aux/IAA 降解子与受体的相互作用。TIR1 是 SCF 泛素连接酶的底物识别组分。
description.en: Auxin occupies a TIR1 pocket and stabilizes engagement of the Aux/IAA degron. TIR1 is the substrate-recognition component of an SCF ubiquitin ligase.

description.zh: SCF 体系促进 Aux/IAA 多聚泛素化；图中泛素链为示意，不表示固定链长。生长素本身不被画成蛋白激酶。
description.en: The SCF machinery promotes Aux/IAA polyubiquitylation. The drawn chain is schematic, with no fixed biological length implied; auxin is not a protein kinase.

description.zh: 带标记的 Aux/IAA 进入 26S 蛋白酶体并被降解。泛素被回收，ARF 蛋白保留在 DNA 上。
description.en: Tagged Aux/IAA is degraded by the 26S proteasome. Ubiquitin is recycled and the ARF remains on DNA.

description.zh: 移除抑制后，激活型 ARF 支持生长素响应基因转录。RNA 在核内按 5′→3′ 延长；后续输出及翻译未在主图展开。
description.en: After repression is relieved, activating ARF supports auxin-responsive transcription. RNA elongates 5′→3′ in the nucleus; export and translation are not expanded in the main view.

description.zh: 幼茎中包括 SAUR 在内的下游调节可促进细胞壁酸化和伸长；两侧反应不同可产生差异生长。小图概括较晚的结果，不把核内信号与机械伸长视为同一步。
description.en: In shoots, downstream regulators including SAUR proteins can promote wall acidification and elongation. Unequal responses across a tissue can yield differential growth. The inset summarizes later events rather than equating nuclear signaling with immediate mechanical extension.

description.zh: FLS2 的长 LRR 胞外结构域朝向质外体，激酶域位于胞质。BAK1 是较小的共受体，BIK1 在膜的胞质侧工作。
description.en: FLS2 exposes its long LRR ectodomain to the apoplast and its kinase domain to the cytosol. BAK1 is a smaller coreceptor; BIK1 works on the cytoplasmic face.

description.zh: flg22 沿 FLS2 胞外 LRR 结构的内表面结合。这是识别特定微生物模式的例子，而不是把整个细菌吞入细胞。
description.en: flg22 binds along the inner surface of the extracellular FLS2 LRR solenoid. This is recognition of a specific microbial pattern, not engulfment of a bacterium.

description.zh: BAK1 接触 FLS2–flg22 界面并形成受体复合物，膜内侧激酶域的相互作用支持磷酸化和信号启动。
description.en: BAK1 contacts the FLS2–flg22 interface, assembling the receptor complex. Cytosolic kinase interactions support phosphorylation and signaling.

description.zh: 受体相关胞质激酶 BIK1 被激活并磷酸化 RBOHD 的胞质调控区。图示突出直接调控关系，不表示 BIK1 是活性氧产生的唯一输入。
description.en: Activated receptor-associated cytoplasmic kinase BIK1 phosphorylates the cytosolic regulatory region of RBOHD. This depicts direct regulation, not BIK1 as the sole input for ROS production.

description.zh: RBOHD 从胞质 NADPH 获取电子，经跨膜部分传至质外体氧分子，生成超氧阴离子。电子运动与配体进入细胞是两回事。
description.en: RBOHD accepts electrons from cytosolic NADPH and transfers them through its membrane domain to apoplastic oxygen, generating superoxide. Electron transfer does not imply ligand entry into the cell.

description.zh: 超氧阴离子可进一步形成过氧化氢，参与防御信号。无配体对照不出现本模型中的诱导输出；基础活性及其他免疫分支被省略。
description.en: Superoxide can give rise to hydrogen peroxide, contributing to defense signaling. The no-ligand control lacks this modeled induced output; basal activity and other immune branches are omitted.

label.zh: 细胞壁侧的活性氧输出
label.en: ROS output on the cell-wall side

label.en: ROS output on the cell-wall side

description.zh: 细胞壁位于质外体侧；泵和同向转运体嵌在同一片质膜中。
description.en: The wall is on the apoplastic side; the pump and symporter span the same plasma membrane.

description.zh: H⁺-ATPase 的胞质侧催化结构利用 ATP 水解，将质子从胞质送入质外体。
description.en: The cytosolic catalytic domain uses ATP hydrolysis to move protons from cytosol to apoplast.

description.zh: 向外泵送建立跨膜的质子浓度差和电势差；质子回流可释放自由能。
description.en: Outward pumping establishes a proton concentration difference and membrane potential; proton return can release free energy.

description.zh: 蔗糖与质子到达 SUC2 的外侧入口。转运体的选择性不等于膜对蔗糖自由通透。
description.en: Sucrose and a proton approach the outer-facing SUC2 site. Transporter selectivity does not make the lipid membrane freely permeable to sucrose.

description.zh: SUC2 改变朝向，使质子回流与蔗糖进入胞质相耦合；SUC2 本身不水解 ATP。
description.en: SUC2 changes access, coupling proton return to sucrose entry into the cytosol; SUC2 itself does not hydrolyze ATP.

description.zh: 先由 ATP 驱动质子泵，再由梯度驱动摄糖。无 ATP 且无初始梯度时，本模型不能完成净摄取。
description.en: ATP first powers the proton pump, then the gradient powers uptake. Without ATP and an initial gradient, this model cannot complete net uptake.

title.zh: 穿过细胞壁的胞质连接

description.zh: 孔道穿过相邻细胞的壁与中胶层。连续的质膜把孔内胞质与壁空间分开。
description.en: The pore crosses the neighboring walls and middle lamella. A continuous plasma membrane separates its cytoplasm from the wall space.

description.zh: 小溶质沿中央连丝管与质膜之间的胞质空间移动，不需要穿越脂双层。画面只跟踪从左到右的分子，交换本身可双向进行。
description.en: Small solutes move between the desmotubule and plasma membrane without crossing a lipid bilayer. Left-to-right trajectories track selected molecules; exchange can occur in either direction.

description.zh: 示意的大体积货物不能被动穿过本孔道。部分蛋白与 RNA 的移动另受靶向、结合蛋白和组织状态调节。
description.en: The illustrated bulky cargo cannot passively cross this pore. Movement of some proteins and RNA is additionally regulated by targeting, binding partners, and tissue state.

description.zh: 切换为积累条件时，壁侧胼胝质颈环增厚并使膜内的可用通路收窄，后续小溶质也受阻。
description.en: Under the accumulation condition, the wall-side callose collar thickens and reduces the available passage inside the membrane, blocking subsequent small solutes in this schematic.

title.en: ER continuity and a distinct cargo route

description.zh: 中央的压缩内质网连接两细胞；本模型的可溶性货物始终在其外侧的胞质套筒中移动。
description.en: The central appressed ER connects both cells; soluble cargo in this model always travels through the cytoplasmic sleeve outside it.

description.zh: 低胼胝质时小溶质到达相邻胞质；积累时通行减少。真实通透性依赖发育与环境，不能仅凭分子质量判定。
description.en: With low callose, small solutes reach the neighboring cytosol; accumulation reduces passage. Actual permeability depends on development and environment, not molecular mass alone.

title.zh: 氧合产生待回收的 2C 产物

description.zh: 每次 Rubisco 氧合产生一份 3-PGA 和一份 2-磷酸乙醇酸。本模型从两份 2C 产物开始，先在叶绿体脱去磷酸。
description.en: Each Rubisco oxygenation yields one 3-PGA and one 2-phosphoglycolate. This model begins with two 2C products, dephosphorylated in the chloroplast.

title.zh: 乙醇酸进入过氧化物酶体

description.zh: 乙醇酸被氧化成乙醛酸，再经氨基转移形成甘氨酸；副产 H₂O₂ 由过氧化氢酶处理。两个碳骨架均保留。
description.en: Glycolate is oxidized to glyoxylate and transaminated to glycine; catalase handles the H₂O₂ by-product. Both 2C skeletons remain intact.

title.zh: 两份甘氨酸进入线粒体

description.zh: 甘氨酸通过膜转运到线粒体基质，接近甘氨酸脱羧酶复合体和丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶。
description.en: Membrane transport brings glycine into the mitochondrial matrix for glycine decarboxylase and serine hydroxymethyltransferase.

title.en: Four carbons become three plus one

description.zh: 两份甘氨酸净形成一份 3C 丝氨酸，释放一份 CO₂ 和氨。氨需重新同化；所需氮循环和还原力未逐项绘出。
description.en: Two glycines yield one 3C serine, one CO₂, and ammonia overall. Ammonia must be reassimilated; the nitrogen cycle and reducing equivalents are not drawn in full.

title.zh: 丝氨酸返回过氧化物酶体

description.zh: 经氨基转移与羟基丙酮酸还原形成甘油酸。三个保留的碳继续一起移动。
description.en: Transamination and hydroxypyruvate reduction produce glycerate. The three retained carbons continue together.

title.zh: 返回叶绿体并消耗 ATP
title.en: Return to the chloroplast and consume ATP

description.zh: 甘油酸进入叶绿体，GLYK 消耗 ATP 将其磷酸化为 3-PGA。缺失 GLYK 时最后转化受阻，甘油酸不能按此途径补回循环。
description.en: Glycerate enters the chloroplast, where GLYK uses ATP to produce 3-PGA. Without GLYK, this final conversion fails and glycerate cannot replenish the cycle by this route.

description.zh: 正常情况下，跟踪的 4C 中 3C 回到 Calvin 循环，1C 作为 CO₂ 释放。该途径是耗能回收，不是额外的固碳或 ATP 生成过程。
description.en: Normally, 3 of the tracked 4 carbons return to the Calvin cycle and 1 is released as CO₂. This is energy-consuming salvage, not additional carbon fixation or ATP generation.

description.en: C₄ shows two cell types; CAM shows one mesophyll cell and an epidermal stomatal inset. These strategies are specialized, not automatic features of ordinary plant cells.

title.en: PEPC makes the first inorganic-carbon capture

description.zh: CO₂ 水合提供 HCO₃⁻，胞质 PEPC 将其加到 3C PEP 上，形成 4C 草酰乙酸。C₄ 发生在叶肉，CAM 的主要摄取期在夜间。
description.en: Hydration of CO₂ supplies HCO₃⁻, which cytosolic PEPC adds to 3C PEP to make 4C oxaloacetate. C₄ capture occurs in mesophyll; the main CAM uptake phase is at night.

description.zh: C₄ 模式中草酰乙酸在叶肉叶绿体还原为苹果酸，再移向维管束鞘。CAM 模式中苹果酸进入液泡储存为苹果酸库，等待白天。
description.en: In C₄, oxaloacetate is reduced to malate in mesophyll chloroplasts and transferred to bundle sheath. In CAM, malate enters the vacuole to build a malic-acid store until daytime.

title.zh: 脱羧在 Rubisco 附近供给 CO₂

description.zh: 玉米主支路在维管束鞘叶绿体通过 NADP-ME 脱羧。所示 CAM 植物白天释放液泡苹果酸，经线粒体 NAD-ME 脱羧，气孔通常关闭。
description.en: The main maize branch uses NADP-ME in bundle-sheath chloroplasts. The illustrated CAM plant releases vacuolar malate in daytime for mitochondrial NAD-ME decarboxylation, usually with closed stomata.

description.zh: 释放的 CO₂ 进入 Calvin 循环；碳浓缩有助于抑制 Rubisco 氧合。PEPC 的首次固定并没有替代 Rubisco，CO₂ 也不是凭空产生。
description.en: Released CO₂ enters the Calvin cycle; concentration helps suppress Rubisco oxygenation. Initial PEPC fixation does not replace Rubisco, and the CO₂ is not newly created carbon.

title.en: Regenerate the acceptor at an energy cost

description.zh: C₄ 的 3C 丙酮酸返回叶肉叶绿体，PPDK 消耗 ATP 再生 PEP。CAM 保留的 3C 骨架进入再生代谢，并与储藏碳的昼夜周转相联；模型不展开全部反应。
description.en: In C₄, 3C pyruvate returns to mesophyll chloroplasts and PPDK uses ATP to regenerate PEP. The retained CAM 3C skeleton enters regeneration metabolism linked to day/night reserve turnover; these reactions are not expanded here.

description.zh: 从左到右依次为 CAP 位点、启动子、主要操纵序列 O1 和 lacZYA。两条 DNA 链反向平行。
description.en: From left to right: CAP site, promoter, primary operator O1, and lacZYA. The DNA strands are antiparallel.

description.zh: 少量已有的 β-半乳糖苷酶将部分乳糖转为异乳糖。异乳糖结合 LacI，使其对操纵序列的亲和力降低。无乳糖时 LacI 保持结合。
description.en: Pre-existing β-galactosidase converts some lactose into allolactose. Allolactose binds LacI and lowers its operator affinity. Without lactose, LacI remains bound.

description.zh: 低葡萄糖通常伴随较高 cAMP；CAP–cAMP 二聚体结合上游 DNA。高葡萄糖时此激活作用较弱。
description.en: Low glucose generally accompanies higher cAMP; the CAP–cAMP dimer binds upstream DNA. This activation is weak at high glucose.

description.zh: LacI 占据 O1 时起始受到强烈抑制；解除抑制后 CAP–cAMP 可促进 RNA 聚合酶起始。没有 CAP 激活时仍可有较低转录。
description.en: LacI occupancy strongly represses initiation. Once repression is relieved, CAP–cAMP promotes RNA polymerase initiation. Lower transcription remains possible without CAP activation.

description.zh: 聚合酶沿模板 3′→5′ 移动，RNA 从 5′→3′ 延伸。同一转录本包含三个结构基因；示意条带不是测量数据。
description.en: Polymerase reads the template 3′→5′ and extends RNA 5′→3′. One transcript contains all three structural genes; schematic strands are not measurements.

description.zh: 有乳糖、低葡萄糖：较强；有乳糖、高葡萄糖：较低；无乳糖：强抑制但不是绝对零表达。图中未逐一展示被抑制条件下罕见的漏转录。
description.en: Lactose present with low glucose: stronger; lactose present with high glucose: lower; no lactose: strongly repressed, not absolutely zero. Rare leaky transcription in repressed conditions is not individually drawn.

description.zh: TrpR 感知游离色氨酸；翻译先导肽的核糖体间接感知带色氨酸的 tRNA。不是所有细菌都采用大肠杆菌的这一机制。
description.en: TrpR senses free tryptophan; the ribosome translating the leader peptide indirectly senses charged tRNAᵀʳᵖ. Not all bacteria use this E. coli mechanism.

description.zh: 色氨酸作为辅阻遏物结合 TrpR，使它结合操纵序列并降低新转录的起始。下方仍跟踪一条已经起始的 RNA，不能据此推断大量表达。
description.en: Tryptophan acts as a corepressor: it binds TrpR, enabling operator binding and reducing new initiation. Below, we still follow one already initiated RNA; this does not imply abundant expression.

description.zh: 转录与翻译相偶联。先导肽区域 1 含两个连续的色氨酸密码子，读取它们需要带色氨酸的 tRNAᵀʳᵖ。
description.en: Transcription and translation are coupled. Region 1 of the leader encodes two adjacent tryptophan codons; reading them requires charged tRNAᵀʳᵖ.

description.zh: 带色氨酸 tRNA 不足时核糖体停在区域 1，区域 2 可与 3 配对。充足时核糖体前进并遮挡区域 2。充电受限可在游离色氨酸充足时仍引起停滞。
description.en: When charged tRNA is scarce, the ribosome stalls in region 1, freeing region 2 to pair with 3. When abundant, it advances and occludes region 2. Limited charging can cause stalling even when free tryptophan is high.

description.zh: 2:3 反终止发夹阻止 3:4 终止发夹形成；区域 2 被遮挡时，3:4 发夹与其后的富 U 序列促成内在终止。
description.en: The 2:3 antiterminator prevents formation of the 3:4 terminator. When region 2 is occluded, the 3:4 hairpin and following U-rich tract promote intrinsic termination.

description.zh: 停滞条件下，已起始的聚合酶读穿衰减子，进入 trpEDCBA；带色氨酸 tRNA 充足时多在先导区终止。TrpR 仍独立限制起始频率。
description.en: Under stalling conditions, the initiated polymerase reads through the attenuator toward trpEDCBA. With abundant charged tRNA, termination in the leader is favored. TrpR independently constrains initiation frequency.

description.zh: Gal4 二聚体结合 UAS；Gal80 覆盖其转录激活域。DNA 结合与激活转录是两个不同步骤。
description.en: A Gal4 dimer occupies its UAS. Gal80 masks its transcriptional activation domain. DNA occupancy and transcriptional activation are different steps.

title.zh: Gal3 感知半乳糖与 ATP

description.zh: 半乳糖和 ATP 结合 Gal3，稳定可与 Gal80 结合的闭合构象。Gal3 是感知蛋白，不是将半乳糖磷酸化的主要酶。
description.en: Galactose and ATP stabilize a closed Gal3 conformation capable of binding Gal80. Gal3 is a sensor, not the main galactose-phosphorylating enzyme.

description.zh: 激活的 Gal3 与 Gal80 相互作用，使 Gal4 激活域可用。图中用 Gal80 离开激活域表示抑制解除，不把核质运输作为必需步骤。无半乳糖时遮挡保留。
description.en: Activated Gal3 interacts with Gal80, making the Gal4 activation domain available. Moving Gal80 away represents relief of inhibition without requiring nuclear transport. Without galactose, masking persists.

title.zh: 葡萄糖提供另一层抑制

description.zh: 高葡萄糖下 Mig1 与 Cyc8–Tup1 参与 GAL1 抑制。即使局部 Gal80 抑制解除，葡萄糖也能使 GAL 表达保持低水平；此处省略 GAL4 表达和糖运输调控。
description.en: At high glucose, Mig1 and Cyc8–Tup1 contribute to GAL1 repression. Glucose can maintain low GAL expression despite local relief of Gal80 inhibition. GAL4 expression and sugar transport regulation are omitted.

description.zh: 有半乳糖、低葡萄糖时，暴露的 Gal4 激活域可促进共激活因子和 RNA 聚合酶 II 的募集。新 RNA 在核内以 5′→3′ 合成。
description.en: With galactose and low glucose, the exposed Gal4 activation domain promotes coactivator and RNA polymerase II recruitment. New RNA is synthesized 5′→3′ in the nucleus.

description.zh: 有半乳糖且低葡萄糖时显示诱导转录；其他组合显示受抑制的代表状态。没有画出 RNA 不代表绝对零表达。蛋白质翻译不在这个核内视图中。
description.en: Induced transcription is shown with galactose and low glucose; other combinations show representative repressed states. No drawn RNA does not mean absolutely zero expression. Protein translation is outside this nuclear view.

description.zh: 无高渗冲击时，Sln1 经 Ypd1 使 Ssk1 保持磷酸化，从而抑制下游 HOG 激活。金色标记表示磷酸基团，不代表激活总是增加。
description.en: Without an osmotic step, Sln1 transfers phosphate through Ypd1 to Ssk1, restraining downstream HOG activation. Gold marks phosphate; phosphorylation does not always mean activation.

description.zh: 外界渗透压升高使水净外流、细胞体积下降。Fps1 通道迅速关闭以减少甘油流失；其早期关闭不应全部归因于 Hog1。细胞壁边界只作参照。
description.en: Higher external osmolarity drives net water loss and cell shrinkage. Fps1 rapidly closes to reduce glycerol loss; early closure is not attributed entirely to Hog1. The wall boundary is a reference outline.

title.zh: 降低磷酸接力以激活支路

description.zh: Sln1 支路的磷酸接力减弱，未磷酸化 Ssk1 促进 Ssk2/Ssk22，随后激活 Pbs2。不是把渗透物直接当作 Sln1 的配体。
description.en: Reduced Sln1 phosphorelay leaves Ssk1 unphosphorylated, enabling Ssk2/Ssk22 and then Pbs2 activation. External osmolytes are not depicted as ligands binding Sln1.

title.zh: Hog1 的胞质与核内作用

description.zh: Pbs2 先磷酸化 Hog1，随后 Hog1 经核孔进入细胞核，参与应激转录，也在胞质调节代谢。不可磷酸化对照缺少这一激活步骤；催化活性降低本身不必阻止入核。
description.en: Pbs2 first phosphorylates Hog1; Hog1 then enters the nucleus through a nuclear pore, contributing to stress transcription as well as cytoplasmic metabolic regulation. The nonphosphorylatable control lacks this activation step; reduced catalytic activity alone need not prevent import.

description.zh: HOG 促进包括 GPD1 在内的应答，配合代谢调节增加胞质甘油。关闭 Fps1 减少外流；三碳结构代表甘油，数量仅表示相对积累。
description.en: HOG promotes responses including GPD1 expression and metabolic regulation that increase cytoplasmic glycerol. Closed Fps1 reduces efflux. Three-carbon shapes represent glycerol; counts indicate only relative accumulation.

description.zh: 积累的相容性溶质减小跨膜水势差，使体积恢复并降低 HOG 信号。Hog1 不可磷酸化时恢复受损；本模型不预测存活率，也不穷尽其他补偿机制。
description.en: Accumulated compatible solute reduces the water-potential difference, allowing volume recovery and HOG signal attenuation. Recovery is impaired with nonphosphorylatable Hog1. This model predicts neither survival nor every compensatory mechanism.

description.zh: 核心 RNA 聚合酶与 σ70 结合成全酶。图中突出 −35 与 −10 启动子区域，省略实际碱基序列。
description.en: Core RNA polymerase associates with σ70 to form holoenzyme. The −35 and −10 promoter regions are highlighted; base sequences are omitted.

description.zh: 局部 DNA 打开形成转录泡。聚合酶沿模板链 3′→5′ 前进，把核苷酸加到 RNA 的 3′ 端。

description.zh: 聚合酶进入延伸，已经合成的 RNA 的 5′ 端伸出。示意中 σ70 脱离；实际 σ70 的保留时间可有差异。
description.en: Polymerase enters elongation and the existing RNA 5′ end emerges. σ70 dissociates in this schematic; its retention can vary in actual complexes.

description.zh: 30S 与 50S 亚基组装为 70S 核糖体，从已暴露的起始区开始翻译。RNA 的 3′ 端仍连接正在转录的聚合酶。
description.en: 30S and 50S subunits assemble into a 70S ribosome at an exposed initiation region. The RNA 3′ end remains attached to the transcribing polymerase.

description.zh: 核糖体沿 mRNA 的 5′→3′ 方向推进，新生肽从大亚基出口伸出；此时转录仍在继续。图中没有表示直接的蛋白质桥接。
description.en: The ribosome advances along mRNA 5′→3′ as a nascent peptide emerges from the large subunit. Transcription continues; a direct protein bridge is not depicted.

title.zh: 杆状细胞与环形染色体

description.zh: 内膜包围细胞质，肽聚糖位于内外膜之间。染色体是折叠的环形 DNA；示意省略快速生长时的多轮复制。
description.en: The inner membrane encloses cytoplasm, with peptidoglycan between inner and outer membranes. Folded circular DNA is shown; overlapping replication cycles during rapid growth are omitted.

description.zh: 从复制起点启动的两个复制叉沿环形染色体相向推进。新合成的姐妹 DNA 逐步增加，细胞同时延长。
description.en: Two replication forks move in opposite directions around the circular chromosome. Newly synthesized sister DNA increases as the cell elongates.

description.zh: 复制完成的姐妹染色体进入细胞两半，使中部获得分裂空间。真实复制与分离在时间上有重叠。
description.en: Replicated sister chromosomes occupy opposite cell halves, clearing the division site. In real cells replication and segregation overlap in time.

description.zh: 短 FtsZ 丝段在内膜的细胞质侧形成动态支架，膜锚定蛋白及 FtsWI 等隔膜合成组分在中部组织起来。
description.en: Short FtsZ filaments form a dynamic scaffold on the cytoplasmic face of the inner membrane. Membrane anchors and septal synthesis components including FtsWI organize at midcell.

description.zh: 隔膜肽聚糖合成和重塑伴随内外膜向内收缩；FtsZ 在最终封闭之前逐步离开。若隔膜合成受阻，FtsZ 支架仍不能独自把细胞分开；对照停在早期阶段。
description.en: Septal wall synthesis and remodeling accompany inward movement of both membranes; FtsZ leaves before final closure. When septal synthesis is blocked, the FtsZ scaffold alone cannot separate the cell; that condition stalls early.

description.zh: 在正常条件下，包膜闭合、隔膜分离，形成各自具有完整染色体的两个杆状子细胞。新细胞极来自原来的分裂部位。
description.en: With active synthesis, envelope closure and septal splitting produce two rods, each with a complete chromosome. Their new poles arise at the former division site.

description.en: The donor contains a separate double-stranded F plasmid; the recipient initially lacks it. Each cell retains its own chromosome.

description.zh: 接合菌毛伸展、接触受体并回缩，使细胞靠近。细长菌毛与随后的稳定细胞接触区分开表示。

description.zh: TraN 等组分稳定配对，TraI 在 oriT 切开一条链。图中接触区的转移装置被放大；切口受阻时下游转移停止。
description.en: Components including TraN stabilize the pair. TraI nicks one strand at oriT. The transfer apparatus is enlarged; blocked nicking prevents downstream transfer.

description.zh: 与 TraI 相连的 T 链 5′ 端先进入受体，经接触区转移。供体中留下的模板链指导替代链合成。
description.en: The TraI-linked 5′ end of the T strand enters the recipient first through the contact junction. The retained donor strand templates replacement synthesis.

title.zh: 受体闭环并合成互补链

description.zh: 完整的转移链在受体中闭环，互补链合成把单链质粒变为双链；双方的合成时间可重叠。
description.en: The fully transferred strand circularizes in the recipient. Complementary synthesis converts it to double-stranded DNA; synthesis in the two cells can overlap.

description.zh: 转移及补链成功后，双方均有完整 F 质粒。受体建立质粒基因表达后可获得供体能力；本镜头省略该表达延迟。
description.en: After successful transfer and synthesis, both cells carry complete F plasmids. Recipient donor capability requires plasmid gene expression, whose delay is omitted here.

title.zh: 感受态细胞与环境 DNA

description.zh: 镜头已选定感受态亚群中的一个细胞。左侧是游离的双链 DNA 片段，不需要另一活细胞与它接触。
description.en: The scene selects a cell already in the competent subpopulation. Free double-stranded DNA is outside; no contacting live donor is required.

description.zh: 极部感受态装置与 ComEA 参与捕获和结合 DNA。厚肽聚糖层外侧的片段被带至膜上的摄取装置。
description.en: The polar competence machinery and ComEA participate in DNA capture and binding. The fragment outside the thick peptidoglycan layer reaches the membrane uptake apparatus.

description.zh: 一条 DNA 链通过 ComEC 进入细胞质，另一条链被降解。示意只突出这一次跨膜摄取，不把双链整体送入细胞。
description.en: One DNA strand enters the cytoplasm through ComEC while the other is degraded. The model emphasizes single-strand uptake across the membrane.

description.zh: 单链结合蛋白保护输入 DNA，DprA 协助 RecA 装载。RecA 核蛋白丝参与搜索染色体上的同源序列。
description.en: Single-strand binding proteins protect incoming DNA, and DprA helps load RecA. The RecA nucleoprotein filament searches the chromosome for homologous sequence.

description.zh: 有同源区时，输入链先靠近染色体，再局部配对并推进 D-loop 链交换；原有链在接触区域被排开。无同源区的对照仍可摄取 DNA，但不能完成这里显示的同源整合。
description.en: With homology, incoming DNA first approaches the chromosome, then local pairing advances a D-loop; the resident strand is displaced where contact has occurred. DNA without matching homology can enter but cannot complete this homologous integration pathway.

title.zh: 含输入序列的异源双链

description.zh: 整合后的一段染色体含输入链与原有互补链，形成异源双链。这里止于重组；后续复制、错配处理与遗传分离未展开。
description.en: A chromosome segment now contains the incoming strand paired with the resident complement, forming a heteroduplex. Subsequent replication, mismatch processing, and segregation are outside the scene.

label.en: Cytoplasmic DNA processing in B. subtilis

label.en: Natural transformation in Gram-positive B. subtilis with one cytoplasmic membrane

label.en: Cytoplasmic DNA processing in B. subtilis

description.zh: 周生鞭毛的基部散布在细胞表面；游动时丝状鞭毛在后方成束。
description.en: Peritrichous flagella originate at distributed surface motors and form a trailing bundle during a run.

description.zh: 极区的跨膜受体通过 CheW 与胞质侧 CheA 耦联。引诱物增加抑制 CheA 活性。
description.en: Polar transmembrane receptors couple through CheW to cytoplasmic CheA. Increasing attractant inhibits CheA activity.

description.zh: CheA 向 CheY 转移磷酸；CheZ 使 CheY-P 去磷酸化。引诱物增加时，马达附近的 CheY-P 减少。
description.en: CheA transfers phosphate to CheY; CheZ dephosphorylates CheY-P. Rising attractant reduces CheY-P near motors.

description.zh: 较低 CheY-P 降低顺时针切换概率，使逆时针旋转的鞭毛束维持较久；方向并未被直接指定。
description.en: Lower CheY-P reduces clockwise switching probability, preserving a counterclockwise bundle for longer without specifying a direction.

description.zh: 从细胞后方向前看，一个马达转为顺时针；所选鞭毛由左手正常形变为右手半卷曲形并离束，再恢复。此处显示常见的多态转变，非每次反转的必然结果。
description.en: Viewed from behind toward the cell, one motor reverses clockwise. Its left-handed normal filament changes to a right-handed semicoiled form and leaves the bundle, then recovers. This depicts a common polymorphic transition, not a necessary result of every reversal.

description.zh: 重新成束后继续游动。CheR/CheB 介导的受体适应使持续刺激下的偏向回归基线；此处未展开该反馈。
description.en: The bundle reforms for another run. CheR/CheB receptor adaptation restores baseline bias under sustained stimulation; that feedback is not expanded here.

description.zh: NarX 二聚体跨越内膜；感受域位于周质，催化域位于胞质。图中上方不是细胞外空间。
description.en: The NarX dimer spans the inner membrane, with a periplasmic sensor and cytoplasmic catalytic domains. The upper compartment is not the extracellular space.

description.zh: 硝酸盐结合于 NarX 两亚基间的感受口袋，并改变跨膜信号状态。选择缺少硝酸盐可比较未增强的支路。
description.en: Nitrate binds a sensor pocket between NarX subunits and changes transmembrane signaling. Select absent nitrate to compare the unstimulated branch.

description.zh: 胞质侧激酶利用 ATP，将磷酸基团加到 NarX 的保守组氨酸上，留下 ADP。
description.en: The cytoplasmic kinase uses ATP to phosphorylate a conserved NarX histidine, leaving ADP.

description.zh: NarL 接收域先与 NarX 接触，随后磷酸基团由 His 直接转移到保守 Asp；NarL-P 再离开。这是典型两步磷酸转移，不是多级 His–Asp–His–Asp 磷酸接力。
description.en: The NarL receiver first contacts NarX; the phosphoryl group transfers directly from His to conserved Asp before NarL-P departs. This is canonical two-step phosphotransfer, not a multistep His–Asp–His–Asp phosphorelay.

title.zh: 调节 DNA 上的转录

description.zh: NarL-P 结合调控 DNA。在厌氧调节背景下，它促进 narGHJI 硝酸还原酶基因簇的表达。
description.en: NarL-P binds regulatory DNA. In the anaerobic regulatory context it promotes expression of the narGHJI nitrate-reductase cluster.

description.zh: 新 RNA 从 5′ 端向 3′ 端延长。无硝酸盐时不显示这次增强表达事件；基础激酶活性及其他支路并未被设为零。
description.en: New RNA extends from 5′ toward 3′. Without nitrate, this enhanced-expression event is absent; basal kinase activity and other branches are not assumed to be zero.

description.zh: LuxI 是胞质中的信号合成酶，生成 3-oxo-C6-HSL；它不是膜受体。
description.en: LuxI is a cytoplasmic signal synthase producing 3-oxo-C6-HSL; it is not a membrane receptor.

description.zh: 这种短链 AHL 能进出细胞。图中环形符号代表同一种 AHL，运动路径只是扩散示意。
description.en: This short-chain AHL can enter and leave cells. Ring symbols represent the same AHL; paths illustrate diffusion.

description.zh: 相同细胞数也可有不同局部浓度：保留信号有利于积累，持续稀释可阻止充分积累。
description.en: The same cell number can yield different local concentrations: retention favors accumulation while dilution can prevent it.

title.zh: 胞质 LuxR 结合 AHL

description.zh: AHL 结合使 LuxR 形成活性调控复合物，随后结合 lux 启动子附近的 lux box。
description.en: AHL binding enables an active LuxR regulatory complex that binds the lux box near the lux promoter.

description.zh: LuxR–AHL 促进 luxICDABEG 转录。新增 LuxI 可提高信号合成，构成正反馈；图中未展开翻译。
description.en: LuxR–AHL promotes luxICDABEG transcription. Additional LuxI increases signal production, creating positive feedback; translation is not expanded.

description.zh: 在适宜条件下，lux 表达产生发光系统。淡色光晕表示输出状态，不代表实测亮度；持续稀释时不展示此次增强输出。
description.en: Under permissive conditions, lux expression supplies the light-producing system. Halos denote output, not measured intensity; continuous dilution omits this enhanced-output event.

label.en: LuxR–AHL signaling in V. fischeri

label.zh: 费氏弧菌 LuxI–LuxR 群体感应示例
label.en: V. fischeri LuxI–LuxR quorum-sensing example

description.zh: 游离细胞接近固体表面。附着是局部接触过程，最初可逆，并不意味着细胞死亡。
description.en: Planktonic cells approach a solid surface. Attachment involves local contact and can initially be reversible; it does not imply cell death.

description.zh: PAO1 分泌的 Psl 有助于细胞黏附。表面运动与已沉积的多糖影响细胞停留位置。
description.en: Psl secreted by PAO1 supports adhesion. Surface movement and deposited polysaccharide influence where cells remain.

description.zh: 附着细胞的生长和局部聚集形成微菌落；模型用有限数量的代表细胞显示群体结构。
description.en: Growth and local aggregation of attached cells produce microcolonies. A limited number of representative cells depicts the community architecture.

description.zh: Psl 支架与胞外 DNA、基质蛋白共同稳定群体。基质是可渗透的纤维网络，不是包住全部细胞的膜。
description.en: A Psl scaffold, extracellular DNA and matrix proteins stabilize the community. The matrix is a permeable network, not a membrane enclosing all cells.

description.zh: 低水平 NO 可提高磷酸二酯酶活性并降低胞内 c-di-GMP，促进分散。图中未把 NO 画成杀菌处理，也未将此过程等同于群体感应。
description.en: Low-level NO can increase phosphodiesterase activity and lower intracellular c-di-GMP, promoting dispersal. NO is not depicted as a bactericidal treatment or as a quorum-sensing switch.

description.zh: 分散涉及黏附解除与基质重塑，部分活细胞离开，周围基质仍可保留。无新增信号时，本次示意群体保持附着。
description.en: Dispersal involves untethering and matrix remodeling. Some viable cells leave while surrounding matrix can remain. Without the added cue, this illustrative community remains attached.

label.zh: 铜绿假单胞菌 PAO1 生物膜；结构目录暂无细胞外基质
label.en: P. aeruginosa PAO1 biofilm; extracellular matrix is not represented in the structure catalogue

description.zh: 母细胞在皮层形成极性位点，芽颈附近组装隔膜蛋白环。细胞壁局部生长将产生与母细胞相通的芽体。
description.en: A cortical polarity site forms, with septins assembling around the future neck. Local wall growth produces a bud continuous with the mother cytoplasm.

description.zh: 沿肌动蛋白索运输的分泌囊泡向芽体供给膜和细胞壁材料；芽体逐渐增大，芽颈保持连接。
description.en: Secretory vesicles travel along actin cables to supply membrane and wall material to the expanding bud; its neck remains connected.

description.zh: DNA 已复制，细胞核移向芽颈。嵌于核膜的纺锤体极体组织核内纺锤体，并使其沿母芽轴排列。
description.en: After DNA replication, the nucleus moves toward the neck. Spindle pole bodies embedded in the envelope organize an intranuclear spindle aligned with the mother–bud axis.

description.zh: 核内纺锤体伸长，两个染色体组移向母细胞和芽体。核膜不整体解体，而是伸长并穿过芽颈。
description.en: The intranuclear spindle elongates and segregates chromosome sets toward mother and bud. The nuclear envelope stretches through the neck without global breakdown.

description.zh: 细胞核分开后，芽颈的肌动蛋白–肌球蛋白环收缩，质膜与隔膜从芽颈周缘向中心推进，直到中央通道闭合并分隔两侧胞质。
description.en: After nuclear partition, the actomyosin ring constricts. Plasma membrane and septum advance inward from the neck circumference until the central opening closes and partitions the two cytoplasms.

description.zh: 隔膜局部降解使女细胞分离，母细胞留下芽痕。女细胞通常较小；这不是两个等大的细胞从一开始彼此独立。
description.en: Local septum digestion permits separation and leaves a bud scar on the mother. The daughter is usually smaller and arose as a connected outgrowth.

description.zh: 一个六碳葡萄糖进入糖酵解。绿色球用开放碳链追踪六个碳；省略氢、氧及糖环化，保留碳骨架的连接次序。
description.en: One six-carbon glucose enters glycolysis. An open carbon chain tracks its six carbons; hydrogen, oxygen and sugar cyclization are omitted while carbon connectivity is retained.

title.zh: 糖酵解提供 ATP 与 NADH

description.zh: 经多个未逐一展示的步骤，一个葡萄糖转为两个三碳丙酮酸，净生成 2 ATP 并将 2 NAD⁺ 还原为 NADH。这里的 ATP 来自糖酵解。
description.en: Through multiple steps not individually expanded, one glucose yields two three-carbon pyruvates, net 2 ATP, and reduction of 2 NAD⁺ to NADH. ATP shown here comes from glycolysis.

description.zh: 丙酮酸脱羧酶使每个丙酮酸释放一个 CO₂，留下一个两碳乙醛。此步不产生 ATP；CO₂ 是脱羧产物，不是氧气直接燃烧葡萄糖的结果。
description.en: Pyruvate decarboxylase releases one CO₂ from each pyruvate, leaving two-carbon acetaldehyde. This step makes no ATP; the CO₂ is a decarboxylation product, not a result of direct burning by oxygen.

description.zh: 乙醇脱氢酶用 NADH 提供的还原力将乙醛变为乙醇，并再生 NAD⁺。紫色辅酶失去金色标记，表示还原当量的转移，并非完整分子结构。
description.en: Alcohol dehydrogenase uses reducing equivalents from NADH to reduce acetaldehyde to ethanol, regenerating NAD⁺. Loss of the gold mark on the purple cofactor symbolizes reducing-equivalent transfer, not a full molecular structure.

description.zh: 再生的 NAD⁺ 返回糖酵解。一个葡萄糖的六个碳最终分布于两个乙醇与两个 CO₂；从丙酮酸到乙醇的步骤本身不再增加 ATP。
description.en: Regenerated NAD⁺ returns to glycolysis. The six glucose carbons are distributed among two ethanol and two CO₂ molecules. Conversion of pyruvate to ethanol adds no further ATP.

title.en: Oxygen is not the only switch

description.zh: 高糖的酿酒酵母在有氧条件下仍可同时发酵和呼吸，这称为 Crabtree 效应。切换氧气条件可看到环境氧分子出现，发酵仍继续；真实通量还受菌株和培养条件影响。
description.en: With abundant glucose, S. cerevisiae can ferment while also respiring in oxygen: the Crabtree effect. Changing the oxygen condition adds environmental O₂ while fermentation continues. Actual flux depends on strain and culture conditions.

label.zh: 酵母细胞质中的过程；结构目录暂无独立的细胞质节点
label.en: A yeast cytosolic process; no separate cytosol view is available

description.zh: a 细胞分泌 a 信息素，α 细胞分泌 α 信息素，各自的受体识别对方信号。同型 a/a 对照缺少这组互补信号，不启动此处展示的融合流程。
description.en: a cells secrete a-factor and α cells secrete α-factor; each has receptors for the partner signal. The a/a control lacks these complementary signals and does not initiate the fusion sequence shown here.

description.zh: 信息素信号使细胞在 G1 停留并朝向伴侣极化，分泌运输集中到交配突起（shmoo）的尖端；两个细胞此时仍彼此分隔。
description.en: Pheromone signaling arrests cells in G1 and polarizes growth toward the partner. Secretory traffic is directed to the tip of each shmoo projection; the two cells remain separate.

title.zh: 接触与细胞壁局部重塑

description.zh: 相向的突起接触并黏附，融合位点的细胞壁局部重塑，使两层质膜能够接近。整个细胞壁不会同时消失。
description.en: Opposing projections contact and adhere. Local wall remodeling at the junction permits the two plasma membranes to approach; the entire cell wall does not disappear.

description.zh: 质膜融合并扩大连接通道，原来分隔的胞质成为连续空间。此时仍保留两个单倍体细胞核，尚未形成一个二倍体细胞核。
description.en: Plasma-membrane fusion widens a connecting channel and makes the two cytoplasms continuous. Two haploid nuclei still remain; a single diploid nucleus has not yet formed.

description.zh: 与纺锤体极体相关的微管帮助两个细胞核靠近。随后核膜融合，使两个亲本染色体组进入同一个细胞核；这不是减数分裂。
description.en: Microtubules associated with spindle pole bodies help bring the nuclei together. Nuclear-envelope fusion then combines parental chromosome sets within one nucleus; this is not meiosis.

description.zh: 互补配对完成后形成 a/α 二倍体合子，具备两个亲本的染色体组。营养合适时它可通过出芽进行营养生殖；产孢需要另一组营养与细胞状态条件。
description.en: Compatible mating produces an a/α diploid zygote containing both parental chromosome sets. It can bud during vegetative growth when nutrients permit; sporulation requires additional nutritional and cell-state conditions.

description.zh: a/α 二倍体在适合的饥饿条件下从营养生殖转入减数分裂。缺氮且有非发酵碳源是典型诱导条件；营养充足对照不启动这里的产孢过程。
description.en: An a/α diploid switches from vegetative growth to meiosis under appropriate starvation conditions. Nitrogen starvation with a nonfermentable carbon source is a typical induction regime; the nutrient-rich control does not initiate the sporulation sequence shown.

title.zh: 一次 DNA 复制与同源重组
title.en: One DNA replication and homologous recombination

description.zh: 减数分裂前进行一次 DNA 复制。复制后的同源染色体配对并可交换片段；颜色变化仅示意一对同源染色体的一次重组事件。
description.en: A single premeiotic S phase replicates DNA. Replicated homologs pair and can exchange segments; the color exchange schematically shows one recombination event in one representative homolog pair.

title.zh: 第一次分裂分开同源染色体

description.zh: 减数分裂 I 将同源染色体分到两侧，每个同源染色体的姐妹染色单体仍保持关联。染色体组数由二倍体降为单倍体，但染色体仍含两条姐妹染色单体。
description.en: Meiosis I segregates homologous chromosomes while sister chromatids remain associated. Chromosome-set number is reduced from diploid to haploid, but each chromosome still has two sister chromatids.

title.zh: 第二次分裂分开姐妹染色单体

description.zh: 不再进行一次 DNA 复制，两个核内纺锤体分开姐妹染色单体。共同核膜在两轮减数分裂间保持连接，第二次分裂后期形成四个核叶，随后分隔成四个单倍体核。
description.en: Without another DNA replication, two intranuclear spindles separate sister chromatids. The common nuclear envelope stays connected between meiotic divisions, forms four lobes late in meiosis II, and then partitions into four haploid nuclei.

title.zh: 前孢子膜包围核与胞质
title.en: Prospore membranes enclose nuclei and cytoplasm

description.zh: 减数分裂 II 期间，在改建的纺锤体极体附近形成前孢子膜。膜杯生长并最终闭合，各包围一个单倍体核和一部分胞质；模型用相邻的内外膜层与闭合前缘显示包裹过程，膜厚度经过夸张。
description.en: During meiosis II, prospore membranes form near remodeled spindle pole bodies. Membrane cups expand and close around individual haploid nuclei and some cytoplasm. Adjacent inner and outer membrane surfaces and a closing leading edge show enclosure, with exaggerated membrane thickness.

title.en: Spore walls mature within the ascus

description.zh: 闭合后，内侧前孢子膜保留为孢子质膜，甘露聚糖和葡聚糖先沉积在两膜之间；外膜消退后，外侧再形成壳聚糖和二酪氨酸层。四个减数分裂产生的子囊孢子留在母细胞形成的子囊内，本场景不展示释放与萌发。
description.en: After closure, the inner prospore membrane persists as spore plasma membrane. Mannan and glucan first accumulate between the two membranes; after the outer membrane disappears, chitosan and dityrosine layers form outside. Four meiotic ascospores remain in the maternal ascus; release and germination are not shown.

label.zh: 二倍体酿酒酵母的减数分裂与产孢
label.en: Meiosis and sporulation in diploid S. cerevisiae

description.zh: 口沟纤毛将含细菌的水流引向胞口，再进入胞咽。摄入口与后部胞肛位置不同。
description.en: Oral cilia guide bacteria toward the cytostome and cytopharynx. This intake site is separate from the posterior cytoproct.

description.zh: 胞咽末端的膜围住食物并缢断，生成具有独立膜腔的食物泡。
description.en: Membrane at the cytopharyngeal end encloses the food and pinches off as a membrane-bounded food vacuole.

description.zh: 代表性的酸性小泡停靠在新食物泡表面，经可见融合颈递送内容物，先使泡腔酸化；这一步发生在后续溶酶体融合之前。
description.en: A representative acidosome docks at the young vacuole and delivers contents through a visible fusion neck, acidifying its lumen before lysosomal fusion.

description.zh: 代表性的溶酶体在食物泡表面融合并输送水解酶，食物在泡腔内分解；小分子营养随后转移到胞质。
description.en: A representative lysosome fuses at the vacuole surface and delivers hydrolytic enzymes. Food is digested inside the lumen and small nutrients are transferred to the cytoplasm.

description.zh: 剩余不可消化物仍封闭在食物泡内，随胞内运输到后部腹侧的胞肛。
description.en: Indigestible residues remain enclosed as the spent vacuole is transported to the posterior ventral cytoproct.

description.zh: 食物泡膜在胞肛与表面膜融合，残渣排到细胞外；泡膜在细胞内回收，不随残渣整泡排出。
description.en: Vacuole and surface membranes fuse at the cytoproct. Residues exit while vacuole membrane is retrieved inside the cell rather than expelled as an intact vesicle.

description.zh: 低渗水环境使水进入细胞；伸缩泡管网把多余的胞质水分隔到膜内腔。这里放大单个复合体。
description.en: A hypotonic medium drives water into the cell. The vacuolar network segregates excess cytosolic water into its lumen. One complex is magnified here.

description.zh: 海绵体管网围绕集水管；各放射臂通过近端壶腹将液体送入中央泡。
description.en: The spongiome surrounds collecting canals; each radial arm delivers fluid through a proximal ampulla into the central bladder.

description.zh: 中央泡增大。较弱低渗下，进入细胞的净水量减少，模型中的充盈和排水循环相应减慢。
description.en: The central bladder expands. Under less hypotonic conditions, net water entry is reduced and filling and discharge cycles in the model slow down.

description.zh: 中央泡变圆，放射臂与它暂时分离；中央泡膜在固定排水孔处与质膜接通。不同条件下，这一步出现时间不同。
description.en: The bladder rounds and temporarily separates from radial arms. Its membrane connects to the plasma membrane at the dedicated pore. The timing differs between conditions.

description.zh: 液体经孔排出细胞，中央泡缩小，随后孔关闭、放射臂重新连接。较强低渗时更早开始下一轮。
description.en: Fluid exits through the pore and the bladder shrinks; the pore closes and radial arms reconnect. A more hypotonic condition starts the next round sooner.

title.en: Two nuclear types in one cell

description.zh: 小核保存生殖系基因组，大核支持营养期的基因表达。横裂后，每个子细胞都需要这两类核。
description.en: The micronucleus stores the germline genome; the macronucleus supports vegetative gene expression. Each daughter requires both nuclear types.

description.zh: 核DNA在分配前复制，细胞生长并形成后部子细胞的口器。膜与纤毛结构也需随分裂重新组织。
description.en: Nuclear DNA replicates before partition. The cell grows and develops the posterior daughter’s oral apparatus while its cortex and cilia reorganize.

title.zh: 小核的封闭式有丝分裂

description.zh: 小核核膜保持完整，核内纺锤体分离复制后的染色体；两个小核随后分配到细胞的前后两部分。
description.en: The micronuclear envelope remains intact while an intranuclear spindle segregates replicated chromosomes. The two micronuclei move into opposite cell halves.

description.zh: 大核经通常称为无丝分裂的过程伸长、分开，不经历典型的染色体中期排列。无丝分裂不等于不存在微管或调控。
description.en: The macronucleus elongates and separates in a process usually called amitosis, without a conventional chromosome metaphase plate. Amitosis does not imply an absence of microtubules or regulation.

description.zh: 分裂沟位于长轴的横向中部，皮层和细胞膜向内收拢，分开前后两个细胞区域。
description.en: A cleavage furrow across the long axis constricts the cortex and membrane, separating anterior and posterior cell regions.

description.zh: 分离的两个子细胞各具有一个小核、一个大核和口器，随后继续生长。此过程增加细胞数，没有配偶间的核交换。
description.en: Each daughter contains one micronucleus, one macronucleus and an oral apparatus, and can resume growth. This process increases cell number without exchange of nuclei between partners.

description.zh: 两个细胞在口区接触并形成细胞间通路。接合本身不增加细胞数，配偶也不会融合成一个永久细胞。
description.en: Two cells contact at their oral regions and establish an intercellular passage. Conjugation itself does not increase cell number or permanently fuse the partners.

description.zh: 每个尾草履虫的一个二倍体小核经两次减数分裂产生四个单倍体核。大核不参加减数分裂。
description.en: The single diploid micronucleus in each P. caudatum undergoes two meiotic divisions, producing four haploid nuclei. The macronucleus does not undergo meiosis.

description.zh: 靠近口区的一个单倍体核保留，另外三个退化。大核开始碎裂，其片段不会立即全部消失。
description.en: One haploid nucleus near the oral region is retained while the other three degenerate. The old macronucleus fragments; its remnants do not all disappear immediately.

description.zh: 保留的单倍体核再有丝分裂一次，形成留居原核和迁移原核；两者仍为单倍体。
description.en: The retained haploid nucleus divides mitotically to form stationary and migratory pronuclei; both remain haploid.

description.zh: 每个配偶把迁移原核送给对方，自己的留居原核保留。通路内两种颜色分别表示两个亲本来源。
description.en: Each partner transfers its migratory pronucleus while retaining its stationary one. The two colors in the passage represent the two parental origins.

title.zh: 各自融合成二倍体合核
title.en: Each cell forms a diploid synkaryon

description.zh: 外来的迁移原核与本地留居原核融合，恢复二倍体；随后配偶分离，各自保有来自双方的遗传材料。
description.en: An incoming migratory pronucleus fuses with the resident stationary pronucleus, restoring diploidy. Partners separate, each retaining genetic contributions from both.

description.zh: 合核连续分裂三次形成八个核：后部四个成为大核原基；恢复营养供给后，前部四个中选择保留一个小核。旧大核片段可继续存在，之后逐渐丢失。后续两次横裂分配新大核。
description.en: Three synkaryon divisions produce eight nuclei: four posterior nuclei become macronuclear anlagen and, following nutrient provision, one of four anterior micronuclear candidates is retained. Old macronuclear fragments can persist before eventual loss. Two later fissions distribute the new macronuclei.

description.zh: T4 在大肠杆菌表面吸附；尾部介导 DNA 穿过包膜进入胞质，衣壳保留在外侧。此处只概览进入过程。
description.en: T4 attaches to E. coli. Its tail mediates DNA passage through the envelope into the cytoplasm while the capsid stays outside. Entry is shown as an overview.

description.zh: 噬菌体基因在宿主胞质中被转录，宿主核糖体翻译 RNA。T4 重定向细胞资源，宿主 DNA 逐渐降解。
description.en: Phage genes are transcribed in the cytoplasm and host ribosomes translate the RNA. T4 redirects cellular resources and host DNA is progressively degraded.

description.zh: T4 复制蛋白扩增噬菌体 DNA，形成用于包装的连接体。金色曲线表示 DNA，不代表精确拷贝数。
description.en: T4 replication proteins amplify phage DNA, generating concatemers for packaging. Gold strands represent DNA, not an exact copy number.

description.zh: 前头从内膜胞质侧起始装配后成熟；尾与尾纤维通过独立途径装配。分离组件在胞质内等待结合。
description.en: Proheads begin assembly at the cytoplasmic face of the inner membrane and then mature. Tails and tail fibers assemble through separate pathways; components await joining inside the cytoplasm.

description.zh: 包装马达把 DNA 装入成熟前头并切割连接体；随后头部、尾和尾纤维结合，形成具感染性的子代。
description.en: Packaging motors load DNA into mature proheads and cut the concatemer. Heads, tails and fibers then join to form infectious progeny.

description.zh: 晚期裂解系统破坏内膜、肽聚糖和外膜屏障，使胞内成熟粒子释放到细胞外。图中裂口是包膜破坏的示意。
description.en: Late lysis functions disrupt the inner membrane, peptidoglycan and outer membrane barriers, releasing mature intracellular particles. Gaps schematically represent envelope failure.

description.zh: λ 的 DNA 进入大肠杆菌胞质，黏性末端配对后连接成环。外部粒子保留细长的非收缩性尾。
description.en: Lambda DNA enters the E. coli cytoplasm; cohesive ends pair and are ligated into a circle. The extracellular particle has a long noncontractile tail.

description.zh: 在建立溶原的路线中，整合酶与宿主因子促成 attP 与 attB 重组，将 λ DNA 插入宿主染色体。紫色区段表示连续染色体中的前噬菌体。
description.en: During lysogen establishment, integrase and host factors recombine attP with attB, inserting lambda DNA into the host chromosome. Purple marks the prophage within the continuous chromosome.

description.zh: CI 阻遏蛋白抑制主要裂解启动子的转录。整合后的前噬菌体随宿主染色体复制；此时不会持续装配新的噬菌体。
description.en: CI repressor suppresses the major lytic promoters. The integrated prophage is copied with the host chromosome; new phage particles are not continually assembled.

description.zh: 复制后的两份染色体分别传递给子细胞；两者均携带前噬菌体。图中把染色体摊开以显示整合区段。
description.en: Replicated chromosomes segregate into daughter cells, each carrying the prophage. Chromosomes are spread out schematically to expose the integrated segment.

description.zh: 选择无诱导时，两细胞保持溶原。选择 DNA 损伤时，左侧子细胞中的活化 RecA 促进 CI 自切割，解除裂解基因的抑制。
description.en: Without induction, both cells remain lysogens. With DNA damage, activated RecA in the left daughter promotes CI self-cleavage, relieving repression of lytic genes.

description.zh: 在诱导分支中，整合酶、切除酶和宿主因子促成前噬菌体切除。游离的 λ DNA 扩增，随后包装进新头部并连接非收缩性尾。
description.en: In the induced branch, integrase, excisionase and host factors promote prophage excision. Free lambda DNA amplifies, is packaged into new heads and joins noncontractile tails.

description.zh: 诱导时左侧宿主裂解并释放 λ 子代，右侧未诱导谱系保持溶原；无诱导时两细胞均保留前噬菌体。画面不表示条件决定的精确概率。
description.en: With induction, the left host lyses and releases lambda progeny while the uninduced right lineage stays lysogenic. Without induction, both retain their prophages. The scene does not imply exact condition-dependent probabilities.

label.zh: λ 噬菌体溶原示例；λ 的长尾不收缩，区别于结构页的收缩尾
label.en: Lambda lysogeny; its long noncontractile tail differs from the contractile-tailed structural specimen

description.zh: 左侧门户在内膜胞质面启动前头装配；右侧基板启动尾管与尾鞘装配。两套结构此时不相连。
description.en: On the left, the portal at the cytoplasmic face of the inner membrane initiates prohead formation. On the right, the baseplate nucleates tail tube and sheath assembly. They are initially separate.

description.zh: 衣壳蛋白围绕内部支架形成前头；尾管和延伸态尾鞘独立增长。前头支架还未清除，不能直接作为成熟的含 DNA 头部。
description.en: Capsid proteins form a prohead around an internal scaffold while the tail tube and extended sheath grow independently. The uncleared scaffold distinguishes this prohead from a mature DNA-filled head.

description.zh: gp21 清除主要支架组分并切割衣壳蛋白前肽，为 DNA 腾出空间。关闭 gp21 时支架保留，头部后续步骤停滞；尾部仍能继续装配。
description.en: gp21 digests major scaffold components and cleaves capsid propeptides, making room for DNA. With gp21 inactive, scaffold remains and later head steps stall while tail assembly continues.

description.zh: 成熟前头脱离内膜，ATP 驱动的包装系统装入 DNA，并伴随壳体扩张。此处概览包装；门户本身不作为旋转转子显示。
description.en: The processed prohead leaves the membrane. ATP-powered packaging loads DNA while the shell expands. Packaging is summarized here; the portal is not shown as a rotating rotor.

description.zh: DNA 包装完成后，颈部蛋白封闭门户并建立尾部结合位点。独立的尾管、尾鞘和基板完成，长尾纤维等待安装。
description.en: After DNA packaging, neck proteins seal the portal and establish the tail docking site. The independently assembled tube, sheath and baseplate are complete; long tail fibers await attachment.

title.zh: 头尾结合与尾纤维安装

description.zh: 完成包装的头与尾结合，随后安装长尾纤维。所得尾鞘仍处于延伸态；收缩属于感染步骤，不属于装配。gp21 无活性时不会形成完整子代。
description.en: The DNA-filled head joins the tail, followed by long tail fiber attachment. The sheath remains extended: contraction is an infection event, not an assembly step. Inactive gp21 prevents formation of a complete progeny particle.

description.zh: 起点是已经清除主要支架的前头。终止酶系统使 DNA 与门户相遇，gp17 组装成五聚体马达。小终止酶 gp16 的起始识别作用在此省略。
description.en: The starting prohead has had its major scaffold removed. The terminase system brings DNA to the portal and gp17 assembles into a pentameric motor. The initiating recognition role of small terminase gp16 is omitted.

description.zh: 十二聚体 gp20 形成进入头腔的通道；外侧 gp17 结合并水解 ATP。图中门户保持固定，动力来自马达构象循环而非门户作为转子旋转。
description.en: Dodecameric gp20 forms the channel into the lumen; external gp17 binds and hydrolyses ATP. The portal remains fixed in this scene: motor conformational cycling supplies force, not a portal rotor.

title.zh: ATP 驱动 DNA 转位

description.zh: gp17 将双链 DNA 经门户送入头腔。金色核苷酸位点示意 ATP 循环；无 ATP 分支保留对接结构但不增加腔内 DNA。
description.en: gp17 translocates double-stranded DNA through the portal into the lumen. Gold nucleotide sites indicate ATP cycling. Without ATP, the docked machinery remains but lumen DNA does not increase.

description.zh: 包装早期壳体扩张；DNA 在腔内逐渐积累。可见卷曲路径只用于表现空间占据，不指定唯一的基因组排列方式。
description.en: The shell expands early in packaging and DNA accumulates inside. The visible coiled path illustrates occupancy without prescribing a unique genome arrangement.

description.zh: 包装达到头满状态后，gp17 的核酸酶功能将已包装 DNA 与外部连接体分开；包装马达随后离开门户。无 ATP 时不发生这一终止步骤。
description.en: At headful completion, the gp17 nuclease function separates packaged DNA from the external concatemer. The packaging motor then leaves the portal. Without ATP, this completion step is not reached.

description.zh: gp13／gp14 在门户处组装，封闭含 DNA 的头并为尾部连接准备位点。本模型到封口结束，不把包装马达保留为尾部。
description.en: gp13/gp14 assemble at the portal, sealing the DNA-filled head and preparing a tail docking site. The model ends with sealing; the packaging motor is not retained as the tail.
